youtube_title: Craving Junk After A Late Night? Blame Your Sleep | Body Fix #43 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #43. Up all night, and today you want chips, burger, sweets... EVERYTHING?
B is right. SHORT SLEEP boosts hunger signals.
Less sleep: hunger hormone up, fullness hormone down, brain wants a reward.
Fix: Full sleep, protein breakfast, keep healthy snacks close, don't stock junk.
Red flags: Sleepy all day, snoring with gasping, or binges you can't control? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Sleep Foundation - sleep and appetite
